change to work: Advisory and consultation will increasingly occur via collaborative data discovery platforms, requiring analysts to guide stakeholders through existing data assets and metadata, explain reuse possibilities, and support rapid assessment of fit-for-use and feasibility.

description: Ability to facilitate real-time collaborative analytics sessions with stakeholders and integrate their perspectives into actionable recommendations.
historic work: Key Activities: 'Performs detailed analysis, evaluation and review of statistical methods and concepts to improve existing data and determines changes in the statistical needs of clients, assessing the impact on divisional programs and developing options and strategies to manage complex issues and multi-stakeholder relations.'
change to work: Analysis will now also include rapid evaluation of suitability and fit-for-use of administrative/alternative data sources, requiring agile integration of stakeholder feedback and operational impact assessment within platform-enabled environments.
justification: Role requires rapid iterative collaborative assessment, not previously emphasized.

description: Knowledge of metadata standards and ability to assess data assets' fitness and applicability in new contexts.
historic work: Key Activities: 'Performs detailed analysis, evaluation and review of statistical methods and concepts to improve existing data and determines changes in the statistical needs of clients, assessing the impact on divisional programs and developing options and strategies to manage complex issues and multi-stakeholder relations.'
change to work: Analysis will now also include rapid evaluation of suitability and fit-for-use of administrative/alternative data sources, requiring agile integration of stakeholder feedback and operational impact assessment within platform-enabled environments.

description: Ability to use real-time, automated platforms to conduct and communicate feasibility assessments and trade-offs.
historic work: Technical Activities, Skills, Responsibilities, or Efforts: decision_making: 'Assesses client requirements for statistical information; recommends the conduct of feasibility studies or launching of projects; defines project objectives and scope; selects and evaluates research standards and techniques to be used in the conduct of studies and in the reporting of findings as well as the analytical techniques and quantitative analytical methods to be used to integrate and interpret large volumes of data.'
change to work: Decision-making will shift toward recommending reuse of existing sources and explicit cost-benefit trade-offs, facilitated by automated platforms and real-time assessment tools, rather than proposing new studies by default.
justification: Need to frame recommendations around maximizing reuse, feasibility, and stakeholder outcomes using platform tools.

description: Ability to identify, evaluate, and adapt existing administrative or alternative data assets using platform-based tools and metadata.
historic work: Technical Activities, Skills, Responsibilities, or Efforts: decision_making: 'Develops and procures in conformity to guidelines and policies new data sources, performs updates and modifications to program content and coverage to align to international frameworks or classifications and devises new concepts, definitions, methods and models to produce, evaluate, analyze, present and extend statistical information relating to the different subject matter domains (e.g. Energy, BOP, GFS, Environment, Prices).'
change to work: Development and procurement will prioritize identifying and adapting existing administrative/alternative data sources via metadata search and rapid integration, focusing less on bespoke collection and more on platform-enabled evaluation and modification.
justification: Current expectation is bespoke procurement; new skill required is evaluating and integrating existing sources through platform and metadata tools.

development area: Data Discovery Platform and Metadata Tool Use
description: In-depth understanding of real-time data discovery platforms, metadata standards, and automated assessment tools.
historic work: Technical Activities, Skills, Responsibilities, or Efforts: knowledge_of_specialized_fields: 'Knowledge of existing data bases, conceptual frameworks, and the statistical methods and procedures applicable to the work in order to plan, develop and direct a program of detailed analysis, evaluation and research, to improve existing data, develop new methods of producing, evaluating and analyzing data, develop new concepts and extend the application of divisional statistics. Knowledge is also required of other statistical programs (concepts, methods, and databases) related to the area of expertise to identify potential sources of information for special studies, to evaluate possible data conflicts, to integrate conceptually different data from other programs, to explain variances and to recommend changes to other statistical programs.'
change to work: Knowledge of data sources must expand to include platforms for real-time discovery, metadata-driven assessment, and advanced methods for evaluating data fit-for-use and maximizing reuse.
justification: Current focus is databases and program-level expertise, not real-time discovery or automated metadata analysis.

development area: Automated Suitability Scoring and Metadata Standards
description: Capability to interpret and critically assess metadata-driven automated suitability reports, understanding strengths, weaknesses, and limitations of AI algorithms.

change to work: This element will shift to supervising and interpreting automated suitability scoring systems, requiring the analyst to focus on oversight, exception management, legal vetting, and strategic negotiation regarding new data sources.
justification: Requires understanding automated scoring logic to effectively interpret outputs and trust/validate AI-driven assessments.
